From research article at https://breadscience.example.com/kinetics:
Lactobacillus sanfranciscensis flourishes between 30C and 35C producing lactic and acetic acids, while wild yeast Saccharomyces exiguus reproduces optimally around 24C to 27C. Maintaining proofing temperature at 26C yields a balanced acetic-to-lactic acid ratio of 1:3 without compromising loaf volume.
